# Amsterdam Mamas

> > Amsterdam Mamas is a community resource connecting families with children's activities, classes, and programs throughout Amsterdam.

The site features curated listings of youth activities including sports classes, dance programs, fitness courses, and recreational opportunities for toddlers, preschoolers, and young children across Amsterdam neighborhoods like De Pijp and Vondelpark.

## Key Topics

- Amsterdam children's activities
- Kinder sport classes
- Toddler and preschool dance
- Youth fitness programs
- Little Star Fitness
- Damoves dance studio
- De Pijp neighborhood
- Vondelpark activities
- Ages 4-7 programs
- Kids movement classes
- Family-friendly Amsterdam
- Children's sports programs
- Water Babies Amsterdam
- The Little Gym Amsterdam
- Kinderkookkafé

## Sports & Fitness Classes

- [Kinder Sport Class - Little Star Fitness](https://amsterdam-mamas.nl/find-an-activity/kinder-sport-class-little-star-fitness): Little Star Fitness sport classes for children ages 4-7 in Amsterdam

## Dance & Movement Programs

- [Damoves Peuter- en Kleuterdans](https://amsterdam-mamas.nl/find-an-activity/damoves-danspeuterdans-danskleuterdans): Damoves toddler and preschool dance classes in De Pijp Amsterdam
